canonical_project: Cultana / Whyalla AI data centre proposal
notes: Speculative lead for an AI data centre at Cultana near Whyalla (site previously earmarked for a hydrogen plant); SA Government data centre & AI infrastructure strategy (June 2026) explicitly targets the Mid North and Whyalla for AI data centre investment and plans dedicated legislation. No operator, facility scope or planning application verified - lead only (grade C).
